name: bus-control-feasibility-v1
purpose: Small doctoral-thesis supplement, not a publication-level confirmation matrix
source_collection_policy: Common frozen offline initializer, stochastic raw actions
training_mode: Same fixed source-simulator replay for both hybrid branches
qdelta_error: Frozen selected hybrid model six-head prediction loss on target-fit transitions
deployment_rule: H2O v19 quarter-load-sixty, shared by every learned method
notes: Existing offline initializer used all original data blocks; former model-test blocks are not pipeline holdouts.
SUMO evaluation scenes are generated for this comparison, never used for continuation updates.
Terminal transitions remain in real offline and source replay; model augmentation is nonterminal and one-step.
Policy gradient budgets match across continuation methods; model and trust fitting are additional computation.
MC-WM-assisted denotes the hybrid event-model and Bellman-confidence bus adaptation, not an unchanged generic-task implementation.
